violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: Observed there was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold holding equipment: Avantico dessert display coolers (left and right side) in front service area.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS instructed CFM to place ambient thermometer inside of display coolers cold holding TCS cakes and pastries.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Clean plastic to go clam shelled boxes were observed stored with the food-contact surface facing upward on counter in front service area.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying and covered/inverted. CDI: CFM placed plastic to go box inverted on clean contact surface.
